report_name: ShinyHunters Suspect Detained, Cooperating with FBI

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: A prolific hacking and data extortion group responsible for numerous high-profile data breaches. Their operations involve gaining unauthorized access, exfiltrating large databases, and then extorting victims or selling the data on dark web forums. The group has been linked to breaches at Microsoft, AT&T, and Ticketmaster.
threat_actors.goals: Data extortion and sale of stolen data for financial profit.

threat_actors.name: Saif al-Din Khader
threat_actors.description: A suspected key member of the ShinyHunters group, detained in Jordan and reportedly cooperating with the FBI. He was also an administrator for criminal forums Hellcat and BreachForums.

threat_actors.name: Hellcat
threat_actors.description: A criminal group operating a forum of the same name, for which Saif al-Din Khader was reportedly an administrator.

threat_actors.name: BreachForums
threat_actors.description: A criminal group operating a forum of the same name, for which Saif al-Din Khader was reportedly an administrator.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used by ShinyHunters as a typical method for initial access by exploiting vulnerabilities in public-facing applications.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: Used by ShinyHunters to collect large user databases from compromised networks.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: Represents ShinyHunters' monetization model of data extortion and selling stolen data on criminal marketplaces.

identities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI)
identities.description: A U.S. law enforcement agency that was recently targeted by ShinyHunters, who claimed to have breached their systems and stolen sensitive data. The FBI is now reportedly receiving cooperation from the detained suspect, Saif al-Din Khader.
